timeline.step: VPN login: the remote access appliance accepts a successful single-factor login for a valid clinical staff account from an unrecognised overseas address.
Detection: impossible-travel VPN session correlated with the unpatched appliance advisory and raised to P1 by the SOC.
Acknowledged: on-call analyst engaged the member within the P1 target and opened a bridge with Lakeshore IT Operations.
Lateral movement: the VPN session pivots over SMB to a file server using the same stolen credentials.
Credential dumping: an unsigned process reads LSASS memory on the file server, harvesting cached domain credentials.
Containment begins: the VPN account is disabled, the appliance session is terminated and the file server is isolated from the network.
Credential reset: every account exposed by the dump is force-reset and the attacker address is blocked at the perimeter.
Contained: no further authentication from the attacker infrastructure; containment confirmed 2h10m after detection.
Phishing campaign: 34 near-identical mails impersonating the payroll portal reach staff mailboxes from a look-alike domain.
Detection: the email gateway retro-scan flags the campaign and the SOC raises a P2.
Acknowledged: analyst confirms four staff submitted credentials to the harvesting page.
Containment: the campaign is purged from all mailboxes, the look-alike domain is blocked and the four accounts are reset with sessions revoked.
Contained: no successful sign-in from the harvesting infrastructure; awareness follow-up scheduled with the member.
Malware detected on a shared nursing-station workstation after a USB drive is mounted out of hours.
Detection: endpoint agent quarantines the payload and the SOC raises a P2.
Containment: workstation isolated, USB device blocked estate-wide and the account re-imaged.
Contained: no onward connection observed; removable-media policy raised as a finding.
Unapproved remote access tool installed on a diagnostic imaging workstation by a third-party engineer.
Detection: the SOC raises a P2 on the unsigned remote access binary.
Contained: tool removed, vendor session re-established through the approved jump host, change logged with the member.
Out-of-hours administrator logon to the theatre scheduling server from a non-standard workstation.
Detection: the SOC raises a P2 and the acknowledgement target is missed during the overnight handover.
Contained: logon confirmed as an unsanctioned maintenance window; shared administrator account retired in favour of named accounts.
